set: owner-approved 10 frames (question card 2026-11-08), amber + teal home studio as EON-VB6
export: PNG 2400x1792 -> JPEG q88 sRGB 4:2:0, metadata stripped (ImageMagick -strip), 306-902 KB

01-hero.from: edit of v1 (job 7693de95-fc3a-4fce-bb9a-7c2bb78f1e18) with the reference stone crop; only groove, bevels and stone rim changed

rejected.why: groove drawn as a double-line channel and the edges as narrow steps instead of the reference's single fine line and angled bevels; stone size (about one third of the width) and flush seat were right

02-stone.qa: stone alone about one third of the band width, flush, on the off-centre groove; rim a little wider than the reference's, same as the hero

04-hand-m.qa: left hand, ring on the fourth finger: the finger next to it is the shortest and outermost (little finger)

05-inside.qa: stone at twelve o'clock level with the band's outer curve (VB6 05 v1 had read proud here)

06-hand-w.qa: ring on the fourth finger; one ring, no other jewellery; hand beside the cup, not holding it

07-metals.qa: yellow, white, rose left to right; one stone each on the groove

08-scale.qa: hand seen from the side, so the thumb shows its thickness (~16 mm): ring/thumb 1.41 against a real ~1.37

rejected.why: ring 1.69x the thumb and the band 0.46 of the ring's height (real 0.27): read as a short wide tube
edit of v1 fixed the band (0.28) but not the ring's size: the edit was told to keep the finger positions, and in a pinch the fingertip gap IS the ring's diameter
edit of v2 asking for a 40% smaller ring came back unchanged

09-light.qa: still a low front view, but the stone sits to one side and more of the ring shows; set sheet no longer reads it as a copy of 02

rejected.why: straight-on front view with the stone centred: near-copy of 02's composition on the set sheet (owner brief: a different angle per image)
